units: Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵃ top השיריין מ׳ shirayin (Mish.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 4:2:3">Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>יהב דינרין למ׳</he> gave an earnest money on silk.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:12">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> information was brought against them <he>כד … בהדין מ׳</he> that they dealt in silks (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Sericum).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117b:4">B. Kam. 117ᵇ</cite> <he>ההיא דאחוי אמ׳ וכ׳</he> one informed (the royal officers) of the silk goods of R. A.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מְטַכְסִין</he>, <cite ref="M00997"><he>מִיטַ׳</he></cite>, <he>מְטַכְסֵי</he>, <cite ref="M00997"><he>מְטַק׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 1:6">Targ. Esth. I, 6</cite> (h. text <cite ref="B00308"><he>בּוּץ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 40:1">Gen. R. s. 40</cite> <he>דמ׳ אנא יהיב</he> I am willing to pay the duty on silk goods.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 6:7:2">Y. B. Kam. VI, end, 5ᶜ</cite> <he>מ׳ הוה מלא</he> it (the bag) contained silk goods.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77:2">Gen. R. s. 77</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00866"><he>מחיילא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6:2">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>; a. fr.
